mainEntity.name: What does an AI digital product sales funnel actually need?

acceptedAnswer.text: The basic sales path is audience attention, a useful free resource or message, an opt-in page, follow-up, an offer page, checkout, delivery, and customer support. Not every product needs every step, but buyers need a clear explanation of value and an easy way to receive what they purchased. Context: Run My AI Biz describes workflows involving lead magnets, opt-in pages, bridge pages, thank-you pages, email sequences, sales pages, and delivery setup. Key factors: price, audience trust, purchase complexity, traffic source, refund expectations, and product format. Practical guidance: test the entire path with a separate email address and a low-risk payment or preview process before promotion. Require approval before an AI-assisted workflow publishes pages, sends messages, or spends money. Run My AI Biz can help you map the funnel and identify missing handoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: At minimum, buyers need a clear offer, a trustworthy sales page, an easy checkout, reliable delivery, and a way to receive support. A lead magnet and email sequence can help build demand. Test every page, link, email, and delivery step before sending traffic.
